gen-bungee-inline-gf-hepta-slab: Retro and decorative, Bungee Inline spaces its glyphs out like beads on a cord. And Hepta Slab, a classic serif, stretches its words out too, with open counters and one steady stroke.
gen-bungee-inline-gf-padyakke-expanded-o: Decorative and retro, Bungee Inline spreads its glyphs apart like beads on a cord. Padyakke Expanded One is a serif with pitcher-wide c mouths and round bowls whose walls never swell, so both keep a neon-tube line.
gen-butcherman-gf-graduate: Dark and raw, Butcherman keeps its letters from ever touching, with a dominant x-height. Graduate, a serif with wire-thin, uniform strokes, would outshout the heading if Butcherman were made small.
gen-butcherman-gf-hanuman: Butcherman is dark and raw, its closed letters never touching and its apertures mere slots. Hanuman, a classic serif with a high-waisted lowercase, would carry a traditional, refined feel over pages.
gen-butcherman-gf-kadwa: Raw, dark, gritty: Butcherman's closed letters never touch, and its slot-like apertures stay tight against Kadwa's open curves. Kadwa, a classic serif with a large x-height, would flow through longer text.
gen-butcherman-gf-noticia-text: Raw and dark, Butcherman is made to grab the eye, each letter held apart. Noticia Text, a text serif with big visible curve entrances, does the quiet work of carrying the words.
gen-butcherman-gf-piazzolla: Butcherman's letters never brush shoulders, each one a dark, raw island with slot-like apertures. And Piazzolla, a text serif, pries its e open like a clasp and gives that rawness a refined counterweight.
gen-butcherman-gf-pridi: Letters that never touch their neighbors give Butcherman its dark, raw character, with apertures shrunk to narrow slots. Butcherman shouts; Pridi, a text serif, does the reading through generous curve gaps.
gen-butcherman-gf-scope-one: Scope One, a serif with counters that spill into the space around them, carries stubby ascenders beside a big x-height. But Butcherman is the one that hits, dark and raw with letters kept apart.
gen-butcherman-gf-slabo-13px: Dark and raw up top: Butcherman's letters never touch, and slots stand in for apertures. And Slabo 13px, a serif with large open counters, gives relief beneath that closed heading.
